title: Simpson-Angus Scale (draft v1, awaiting owner review)
description: Ten-item clinician-rated physical examination for antipsychotic- or other dopamine-blocking-drug-induced parkinsonian signs. Emphasizes rigidity; not a patient questionnaire and does not cover every extrapyramidal syndrome. A score alone does not establish etiology.

administration.conditions: Use the same examination conditions and, when possible, the same trained rater for serial assessments. Observe spontaneous movement before eliciting signs. Examine both sides; document asymmetry, pain, arthritis, injury, or other conditions affecting the result. Omit any unsafe maneuver.
context_prompts_not_scored: Since the medication was started or changed, have you felt slower or stiffer?
Have your hands, arms, legs, jaw, or body been shaking, especially while resting?
Have you noticed smaller steps, shuffling, reduced arm swing, difficulty starting or stopping, or falls?
Have you had excess saliva, drooling, or difficulty speaking because of saliva?
When did each symptom begin, and does it change after a medication dose?
administration.prompts_note: Context prompts must not be added to the SAS score.

items.prompt: Gait: observe walking at a natural pace (posture, step pattern, arm swing). 0 normal gait and arm swing; 1 reduced arm swing; 2 markedly reduced arm swing with evident rigidity; 3 stiff gait with arms held rigidly in front of the abdomen; 4 stooped shuffling gait with propulsion and retropulsion.

Arm dropping: patient and examiner raise arms to shoulder height and let them fall. 0 free fall with clear slap and rebound; 1 slightly slowed, quieter, little rebound; 2 slowed without rebound; 3 markedly slowed without audible slap; 4 very slow descent as if against strong resistance.

Shoulder shaking: flex one elbow to 90 degrees, hold hand and elbow, move upper arm back and forth with humeral rotation; repeat other side. Judge resistance. 0 normal tone; 1 slight stiffness; 2 moderate stiffness; 3 marked rigidity making movement difficult; 4 extreme rigidity, joint nearly fixed.
items.source_locator: parkinsonism-criteria.md §SAS 3. Shoulder shaking (anchors shared for items 3-5)

items.prompt: Elbow rigidity: with elbow at 90 degrees, passively flex and extend while observing/palpating biceps; repeat other side. 0 normal; 1 slight stiffness; 2 moderate stiffness; 3 marked rigidity; 4 extreme rigidity, nearly fixed.

Wrist rigidity (fixation of position): stabilize wrist, hold fingers, passively move through flexion/extension/radial/ulnar deviation; repeat other side. 0 normal; 1 slight stiffness; 2 moderate stiffness; 3 marked rigidity; 4 extreme rigidity, nearly fixed.

Leg pendulousness: patient seated with lower legs hanging freely; grasp ankle, partially extend knee, release; assess resistance and swing; repeat other side. 0 free swing; 1 slight reduction; 2 moderate resistance; 3 marked resistance with rapid damping; 4 no swing.

Head dropping: patient supine on a padded surface; support and gently raise the head, withdraw the hand, observe the fall. Omit if neck disease/injury/pain/instability or other safety concern. 0 falls fully and promptly; 1 slight slowing (softer contact); 2 clearly visible moderate slowing; 3 stiff slow descent; 4 rigid neck prevents reaching the surface.
Glabellar tap: patient keeps eyes open without blinking; tap glabella steadily and rapidly, count consecutive blinks. 0: 0-5 blinks; 1: 6-10; 2: 11-15; 3: 16-20; 4: 21 or more.

Tremor: observe while walking into the room and during the examination, limbs at rest. 0 none; 1 mild finger tremor visible and palpable; 2 intermittent hand/arm tremor; 3 persistent tremor of one or more limbs; 4 generalized or whole-body tremor.

Salivation: observe while speaking, then ask the patient to open the mouth and elevate the tongue. 0 normal; 1 excess pools only with mouth open and tongue raised; 2 excess present, occasionally interferes with speech; 3 speech difficult from excess saliva; 4 overt persistent drooling.

completeness.rule: All 10 items required when parkinsonism status is present. Absent and not_assessed require no questionnaire completion. Do not calculate a standard total or mean when an item is missing unless the applicable protocol provides a prespecified missing-data rule; no such rule is defined here. Record why the item was not assessed. Missing suppresses total and mean to null (never zero).

scoring.item_score: 0 normal/absent to 4 most severe for that item.
scoring.raw_total: Sum of the 10 item scores; range 0-40. Higher scores indicate more severe parkinsonian signs at one point in time.
scoring.mean_score: Raw total divided by 10; range 0-4 (original global score).
scoring.original_normal_range: Original convention: mean up to 0.3 within normal; mean greater than 0.3 (raw total 4 or more) considered abnormal. Interpret alongside medication timing, functional impact, differential, and follow-up; neither a threshold nor improvement independently proves causation.
scoring.later_screening_threshold_not_universal: A later validation study in a chronic antipsychotic-treated schizophrenia population proposed 0.65 as a screening threshold (operationally mean 0.7 or greater, raw 7 or more). This is not a universal diagnostic cutoff and must not replace clinical assessment.
scoring.no_severity_bands: The original SAS does not define validated mild, moderate, and severe total-score bands. No such bands are assigned here from locally reproduced cutoffs.

urgent.note: Fever, altered consciousness, autonomic instability, and severe generalized rigidity require urgent evaluation for neuroleptic malignant syndrome rather than attribution to uncomplicated parkinsonism. Urgent handling is independent of questionnaire completion.

source.note: Item wording and anchors follow parkinsonism-criteria.md §SAS verbatim in meaning.

assumptions: Ten items 0-4 with raw total 0-40 and mean 0-4 are the complete SAS per the supplied criteria.
No missing-data rule is defined in the source; suppression-to-null is the default.

independent_examples.name: all_zero_normal
independent_examples.expected: complete; raw_total 0; mean 0.0; within original normal range; no severity band assigned.

independent_examples.name: all_one_abnormal_no_bands
independent_examples.expected: complete; raw_total 10; mean 1.0; abnormal per original convention; no mild/moderate/severe band assigned.

independent_examples.name: one_missing_suppresses
independent_examples.expected: partial; missing [sas_salivation]; raw_total null; mean null (never zero).

severity_mapping.reviewed_severity: Independent clinician-reviewed severity (mild|moderate|severe) recorded alongside the SAS when status is present; it is NOT derived from SAS total/mean bands (none exist). Absent/not_assessed carry null severity. Concrete severity wording requires owner review.
severity_mapping.no_bands_from_total: No universal mild/moderate/severe score bands are created from historical thresholds.

network_mappings.F3_parkinsonism: Effect presence plus reviewed severity plus history context (onset, medication timeline, alternative causes via approved structured history, never page notes). SAS items are measurement context only.

mapping_gaps: Onset/alternative-cause facts beyond h_alternative_cause_considered need owner review before package use (S35).
Reviewed severity wording (mild/moderate/severe) requires owner review; no SAS-derived bands are substituted.
